page_title: GEN 2-2 CAG | Genoa v Cagliari 24/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Simone Sozza is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Vitinha (Genoa) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
90+4' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly changes the colour of the card shown to Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) to a yellow. Play continues.

90+3' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Nicolas Viola (Cagliari), but referee Simone Sozza must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90+2' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) receives his marching orders. Even some of the opposing players are surprised with the strictness of the referee's decision, but he has to leave the pitch immediately.

90+1' That's unlucky! Vitinha (Genoa) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Patrick Vieira has decided to substitute Aaron Martin and he is replaced by Vitinha (Genoa).
89' Andrea Pinamonti comes off the pitch to be replaced by Mario Balotelli (Genoa).
88' 2 - 2 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) high into the middle of the goal, giving goalkeeper Nicola Leali no chance!
88' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
86' Mattia Bani (Genoa) uses the wrong choice of words while trying to explain something to the referee and receives a yellow card for dissent.
86' Simone Sozza couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Aaron Martin (Genoa) and blew his whistle. Cagliari are awarded a penalty kick!
86' The resulting corner from Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
85' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Now Cagliari have a corner.

85' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) is first to react to a lofted pass from Aaron Martin, but fires his header miles over the bar from near the penalty spot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
83' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the left post, but Nicola Leali is prepared and dives to thwart him.

80' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
79' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Aaron Martin (Genoa) was quite harsh and Simone Sozza didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
78' A brilliant cross into the box finds Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa), who directs his header to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
77' Substitution. Fabio Miretti will be replaced by Johan Vasquez (Genoa).
77' Substitution. Alessandro Zanoli did his best and is replaced by Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa).
76' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) replacing Gianluca Gaetano.
76' Here's the change. Michel Adopo leaves the pitch and Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) comes on as a substitute.
75' A pass by Michel Adopo (Cagliari) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
74' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
72' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alen Sherri intercepts the ball.
72' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
71' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out. The referee blows his whistle, Cagliari are awarded a corner kick.

71' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Cagliari can continue in their attacking effort.

70' Junior Messias (Genoa) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
70' Aaron Martin (Genoa) will take the corner.

69' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Alen Sherri pulls off a brilliant save. Genoa will take a corner kick.
68' Davide Nicola prepares a substitution. Razvan Marin is replaced by Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Stefano Sabelli leaves the pitch and Junior Messias (Genoa) comes on.

68' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
66' A yellow card for a tackle by Razvan Marin (Cagliari). Simone Sozza doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
66' Aaron Martin (Genoa) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
64' Here is a change. Tommaso Augello is going off and Davide Nicola gives the last tactical orders to Adam Obert (Cagliari).
64' Substitution. Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) in, Nadir Zortea out.
64' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
62' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) attempts to find Fabio Miretti, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is out of play. Cagliari will have a throw-in.
59' 2 - 1 Goal! Morten Thorsby tees up Fabio Miretti (Genoa) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:1.

58' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Nicola Leali leaps like a salmon to deny him.
57' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Tommaso Augello, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
56' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
54' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Aaron Martin (Genoa), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

54' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom right corner, but Alen Sherri is equal to it and makes an easy save. Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.
52' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) is caught offside once again.
51' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) commits a rough challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Cagliari.

50' Nicola Leali makes a brilliant save! Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
49' Cagliari play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
45+2' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

45+2' Nicola Leali was forced into action to thwart Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper. Cagliari win a corner.
45+1' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' Mattia Bani (Genoa) is able to continue to play.
42' The game is interrupted now, Mattia Bani (Genoa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
42' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
39' Aaron Martin (Genoa) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
39' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
38' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Simone Sozza who sees an offensive foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Cagliari.
37' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Aaron Martin (Genoa) took the corner.

37' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the right side of the goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Alen Sherri. The ball is out of play. Genoa win a corner kick.

34' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) picks up a rebound after a melee on the edge of the box. His first-time shot is poor, though, and curls well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
34' The corner kick from Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

34' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play. Cagliari are awarded a corner kick.

32' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) is first to a cross from Gabriele Zappa and thunders in a great header at goal from near the penalty spot that flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
27' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Tommaso Augello (Cagliari). The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Cagliari.
27' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Aaron Martin (Genoa), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
24' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Cagliari, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.

22' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) displays brilliant awareness inside the box to pounce on the rebound. From a difficult position he directs a header towards the middle of the net, but Nicola Leali pulls off a decent save to deny him.

21' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) comes close to scoring. He peels away from his marker and gets on the end of a cross from Milan Badelj, but he hits a shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.

20' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
20' Corner kick. Razvan Marin (Cagliari) is ready to send the ball into the box.
15' Simone Sozza blows his whistle. Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) commits a foul after dangerous play. Genoa have a free kick.
14' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Fabio Miretti (Genoa) sends it out of play.
12' 1 - 1 Goal! Morten Frendrup (Genoa) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.

11' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) holds his head in his hands after missing a big chance. He latches on to a rebound, creates some space from himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
8' 0 - 1 Razvan Marin (Cagliari) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Nicola Leali to move before rolling the ball into the middle of the goal!
8' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
8' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
7' There's a break in play and referee Simone Sozza must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Cagliari using VAR. This could be interesting!
7' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cagliari comes to nothing.
5' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and Cagliari manage to earn a corner.
4' Genoa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
3' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) commits a rough foul. Simone Sozza stops the game and makes a call. A free kick has been awarded to Genoa.
2' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Genoa.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Genoa will have the kick-off.
Simone Sozza was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
